title: Select
description: Specify the sample elements and choose local or online sources of structural data.
notice: Searching large databases and processing extensive series may take time on a slower computer. Do not close the application: the current operation is shown in the progress window and status bar.

title: Process
description: Adjust smoothing and separate the physical or amorphous background while preserving diffraction peak shapes.

title: Find
description: Match identifies the primary phase, while Gain progressively explains the remaining and overlapping peaks.

title: Inspect
description: Review the classification, unit-cell parameters, atomic positions, and source record for each phase.

title: Compare
description: Combine XRD series in multi-pattern mode and track phase changes across compositions or temperatures.

title: Configure
description: Control axes, scaling, grid, labels, markers, legends, and figure proportions.

title: Export and share
description: Export publication-ready figures and store XRD data, user CIF files, and results in a portable .xpff project.
